Matrices

```{r}
(Keanu <- matrix(1:12, nrow=4, ncol=3, byrow=TRUE))
```
Extract elements of the matrix.

```{r}
Keanu[3, 2]
Keanu[3,]
Keanu[,2]
Keanu[,c(2, 3)]

```
```{r}
colnames(Keanu) <- c("Trinity", "Morpheus", "Neo")

Keanu
```
```{r}
Keanu[,"Neo"]

```
